name: parakeet-cpp
description: Parakeet (NVIDIA FastConformer ASR + Sortformer diarization) inference in pure C++/ggml. Ships CTC, TDT, EOU and Sortformer engines under one Engine umbrella plus the cross-engine StreamEvent API, with an optional Apple Core ML encoder sidecar; sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp engines/parakeet. Port-version 2 corrects the source archive checksum for the e9255b29 IndicConformer multilingual CTC language-masking pin introduced by port-version 1. ggml-speech floor stays 2026-08-07. Consumers use find_package(qvac-parakeet CONFIG) + qvac::parakeet: the installable artifacts live under the qvac-parakeet name so this port is co-installable with whisper-cpp.

coreml.description: Enable the Apple Core ML (Neural Engine) encoder sidecar (Apple-only; presence-driven at runtime).
